text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nwaaahhh!!
While walking around the academy, I suddenly heard a scream that sounded like it resonated from the depths of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!!
T-Trainer-dono...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: For that... please look at your feet.

text_block_list.name: Kittens
text_block_list.text: Meow♪ Purr-purr-purr...♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...While being swarmed by these kids, I had to psych myself up to keep my composure."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I have long possessed a weakness: whenever I behold
the frail and lovely, I am overwhelmed
by the urge to protect them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Just the other day, I was so utterly enchanted by a kitten that I made a disgraceful scene by forgetting my school bag right then and there.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"If things continue like this, I may falter at the crucial moment
and fail to protect the weak in the end."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
An unshakeable heart that doesn't yield to excessive overprotectiveness.
I want to master that... no matter what!
It seems to be a much bigger issue for her than I had thought. So, I decided to do what little I could to help her in her training to attain an "unshakable heart."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hello-woof, I'm Sakura Wanko O-woof!
I want to play lots with Yaeno-san-woof!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Rin, pyo, to, sha, kai, jin, retsu, zai, zen,
Tengen Gyotai Jinpen Jintoriki...!

And so, with help from those around her,
Yaeno Muteki trained hard not to lose to cuteness—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Apparently some puppies were born near the academy!
Care to come take a look with me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No. I am busy with my training,
so I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be like that, man.
Seeing round little doggies napping side-by-side
heals the soul, I'm tellin' ya!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh!!
I will NOT yield!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!?
What's his deal...

text_block_list.name: Baby Dolphin
text_block_list.text: Kyu... kyu?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Look, they're super-duper
interested in Yaeno!
Are you okay!? Can you still hold out!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngggh, OF COURSE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...All right! Over 3 minutes!
It's a new record!!

Yaeno Muteki had grown beyond all recognition,
and was finally ready to face her "Final Trial."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So this is the venue for the final trial.
A "cat cafe"... is it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The trial waiting beyond this door...
To me, it feels just like the grand stage of a GⅠ race."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, my resolve will never waver.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Embracing that adorableness with dignity...
I shall carry the pride of Yaegaki and surge through the front.

"...A serene presence. And yet,
overflowing with confidence. The current Yaeno Muteki
would surely pass this final trial without trouble—"

text_block_list.name: Cat Legion
text_block_list.text: Meow♪ Meow♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I-It's impossible~~!!
...I couldn't overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? I-It's dangerous to climb up
that high! Here, take my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmph?! Gobbling up food like that...
You mustn't choke on it!
Eat slower...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaah! Right onto my lap...!
I-I have to protect them...
No matter what, I must protect this child...!"
choice_data_list: ...Let's just let loose our feelings for now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Regretfully understood!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a blissful paradise...!
Not a single one doubts their peace and safety,
all resting from the bottom of their hearts... What a sight...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I must protect this peace
at all costs...!

"Yaeno Muteki has melted even more than a cat...
It seems even the most rigorous training
can't do a thing about this particular weakness."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? A-An unshakeable... heart...!!
Osu, osu, osu...!

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Naa! Naa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Osu, osu, oshu, oshuu, haah~,
What's the matter, pushing against me like that?
There, there, let me hold you...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, how regrettable! A kick to the shin...
truly isn't something one can overcome~...!"
